research_question: Can a tiny cross-fitted query-level gate improve the strongest fixed 16-byte uniform RPQ sidecar by falling back to the frozen Base ranking on queries with predicted negative correction utility?
scope: post-V14 outcome-informed method development on the already opened V13 query role; not fresh evidence, independent confirmation, an official MS MARCO score, or a production latency claim

parent_evidence.diagnosis: uniform PCA64 RPQ16x8 is the strongest stable 16-byte representation, but it improves 293 and harms 46 queries versus Base on the opened V13 role; V15 leaves every document-side component fixed and learns only whether to apply that correction

evidence_boundary.allowed_claim: whether one preregistered cross-fitted selective gate warrants a new disjoint-query protocol
forbidden_claims: generalization beyond the frozen restricted corpus

input_contract.reuse_reason: query-gate feasibility only; any GO requires a new disjoint query freeze

uniform_sidecar.basis: deterministic uncentred PCA rank-64 fit on residual rows reached by the four outer training folds
uniform_sidecar.quantizer: Faiss RPQ16x8 trained without relevance labels
uniform_sidecar.codes: identical uniform-RPQ representation used by the V13 primary comparator

gate.action: use the complete uniform-RPQ ranking when predicted utility is at least the calibrated threshold; otherwise return the untouched Base ranking
features: mean absolute correction on Base Top-10
mean absolute correction on Base Top-40
maximum absolute correction on Base Top-40
correction standard deviation on Base Top-40
mean signed correction on Base Top-10
mean Top-40 correction divided by Base cutoff margin, clipped at 50
gate.target: per-query uniform-RPQ Recall@10 minus Base Recall@10
gate.model: standardized weighted ridge regression with an intercept
gate.fallback: if no calibration threshold has positive Recall gain and satisfies both ranking guardrails, use the always-on uniform sidecar for that fold and seed

comparators.primary: always-on V13 uniform PCA64 RPQ16x8 using the same fold and seed
comparators.base: committed V13 Base M32 IVF-PQ arrays
comparators.oracle_selective_bound: post-result descriptive max(Base, uniform RPQ) per-query bound; never used to fit or select the gate

prohibited_actions: changing the PCA basis, RPQ codebooks, code assignments, document payload, alpha, or correction depth based on V15 labels
using held-out-fold labels to fit, calibrate, or select the gate
changing features, weights, ridge, threshold grid, coverage bounds, seeds, or gates after outcomes appear
selecting the best seed or fold
opening oracle_audit, future_method_holdout, or any old RARS holdout
claiming the reused V13 role is fresh evidence
claiming production efficiency from the Python evaluator
